name: live-updates
title: Live announcements (Supabase Realtime)
summary: Post an announcement in Supabase and every open browser shows it within a second, with an unread badge and a polling fallback.
when: Event-day or launch-day news: schedule changes, gates opening, a sold-out notice, an emergency message.
env: # Optional, browser-side and safe to expose: RLS limits the anon key to
# PUBLISHED updates. Without these the panel polls /api/updates instead.
next: Apply supabase/migrations/*_live_updates.sql (it enables RLS and adds the table to the realtime publication).
Render <LiveUpdates /> once (e.g. next to your footer), or build your own UI on useLiveUpdates().
Publish: insert a row with published = true, published_at = now().
